    The Krull–Schmidt split–radical normal form #

    Proof of Lemma 2.5, "Split off the invertible blocks of u by Krull–Schmidt decomposition and elementary row and column operations" (graded-category.tex), in any preadditive category with finite biproducts whose objects are finite biproducts of nonzero objects with local endomorphism rings (hasSplitRadicalNormalForm_of_decomp). The argument is the vendored one for finite τ-categories (MBDVendor.QSE.Iyama.splitRadicalForm_finBiproduct), with the finite skeleton replaced by this decomposition hypothesis.

                        z ∈ (Ipow n).hom W U

                        Lemma 2.5 (lem:strict-radical-layers) in a Krull–Schmidt category (objects are finite biproducts of indecomposables with local endomorphism rings) with Auslander–Reiten theory (right almost split maps at indecomposables, with kernel zero or left almost split): for a radical a : U → Y with a + h monic for all h ∈ J²(U, Y), z ≫ a ∈ J^{n+1} implies z ∈ J^n.
